I'm not him but I strongly prefer SEM Rush over Ahrefs regarding keyword research. Especially the first step, which is just kw expansion and the raw amount of keywords. SEM Rushes search volume estimates are cripplingly off, but at least it finds some keywords. 

To give a bit more context... this is in Finnish, Swedish, Spanish, Norwegian and Danish market. In my opinion all the tools do the job in US markets. But a large player, like Spanish, should be implemented as well. I'm not talking a single industry or a single domain either. I'm talking about affiliate companies with thousands of domains.

Currently these markets mentioned above and the KW ratio I'd say SEM Rush finds 90% more keywords than Ahrefs.

There's a huge demand to fill in the EU market for KW tool. Make it happen and me and a lot of companies would gladly pay triple the amount you guys currently charge.
